Hello my friends,

We just crossed 1,000 readers. To mark it, the annual plan of the app is 25% off this week: $150 for the first year, $12.50 a month.

Here is what's inside.

The stock page. The most used screen by a mile. Type a ticker, get the full read: a 0 to 100 score, levels, insider activity, who holds it, and what moved it this session.

The screeners. Re-ranked every night across 12,000 US stocks: momentum, squeezes, insider clusters, post-earnings drift. Each name comes with its conviction score and an AI read of who leads the list.

The Today page. The morning briefing, built overnight. The regime, the day's movers name by name with a read on each, trend alignment on the four majors, and the volatility backdrop.

Two weeks ago the screens flagged $TWST at $91.55. It closed August 13 at $125.29, up 36.9%.

Themes. 26 baskets tracked daily, colored by heat. Open one and you get every name inside, the basket against the S&P 500, and where the options money sits.

Cybersecurity right now: +11.1% this past month, +29.8% over twelve months against +21.6% for the S&P, and the biggest options money 87% in calls on CRWD.

Sectors. Eleven sectors measured against the S&P, each with a verdict: who leads, who fades, who is late. The rotation runs through Energy and Healthcare right now.

Market breadth. The health of the tape scored 0 to 100: advancers against decliners, new highs against new lows, and how many stocks hold their own trend.

The options money map. The session's options flow, name by name: green leans calls, red leans puts, size is the money at work.

Also on the desk: the dealer map with gamma walls, dark pool volume, position tools with stress tests, price and screen alerts, and a weekly best-of email.

The price hasn't moved yet. It will. This week it moves down instead.

Get 25% off

$150 for year one, $12.50 a month. The offer closes Thursday, August 20.

Daniel
